conditions: Re-read the exact receipt under its lock before applying host-derived archived or gone state.

statement: The existing host refresh closes an archived or gone seat once, preserves the reason of an already recorded retirement, and leaves a pending product-owned retirement to its writer.
title: Host refresh closes archived or gone seats once while deferring to pending owner
